operators.name: instance_norm3d_forward
semantics: Computes instance normalization in eval mode using running statistics: y = (x - running_mean[c]) / sqrt(running_var[c] + eps).
Normalization is applied per channel c; running_mean and running_var are broadcast along N,D,H,W.
Equivalent to reference statement: return self.instance_norm(x) with affine=False, track_running_stats=True, and model in eval mode.
No weight/bias scaling is applied because affine=False.
Running statistics are not updated in eval mode.
Output dtype, device, and shape match input x.
Applies InstanceNorm3d to input x. With affine=False and eval mode, the operation is per-channel: y = (x - running_mean) / sqrt(running_var + eps).
Input x shape [512, 3, 48, 48, 48], float32, CUDA after input transfer.
